standard_prerequisites.name: Tor-amplitude in [a, b] can be checked on stalks

standard_prerequisites.name: A flat local ring homomorphism is faithfully flat
Tor-amplitude of a complex descends along faithfully flat ring maps

core_obligations: Only-if direction: pullback preserves tor-amplitude by the cohomology pullback lemma (proof lines 3033-3034).

Reduction to stalks: tor-amplitude in [a, b] is checked on stalks by the cohomology stalk lemma; the stalk maps along f are flat local ring homomorphisms, hence faithfully flat by the algebra lemma (proof lines 3035-3038).
If direction: tor-amplitude of a complex of modules descends along faithfully flat ring maps by the More on Algebra lemma; conclude E has tor-amplitude in [a, b] (proof lines 3039-3041).
proof_roadmap: Reduce the converse to stalks and use faithful flatness of local flat maps (proof lines 3035-3038).
Apply the module-level faithful-flat descent of tor-amplitude (proof lines 3039-3041).
